intro.text: An engineer and artifabrian on Roshar.
One of Queen Navani's most trusted scholars: a former jeweler who became an expert in lenses, polestones, weather readings and astronomy.

items.text: Navani set Talnah and Nem to study the strange black sphere that Gavilar had once given Szeth. Their experiments set off an explosion that destroyed their lab and killed them both. Navani blamed herself, though no one could have expected a sphere to explode, and asked Rushu to examine the lab in detail.

appearance.text: Short, with hair reaching past her ears; she wears a glove on her safehand.

personality.text: Clever and naturally curious, she gets on well with her fellow scholars, including Nem and Rushu.
